levels.name: Low
levels.description: Strong cybersecurity resilience across access controls, patching, and offline backups.

levels.name: Moderate
levels.description: Adequate baseline defenses but noticeable gaps in monitoring, EDR, or third-party controls.

levels.name: High
levels.description: Substantial exposure to ransomware and targeted breaches due to lagging patches or lack of MFA.

levels.name: Critical
levels.description: Severe systemic vulnerabilities, unsegmented internet-facing assets, and absent offline backups.
